name: Steal a Soccer Player
desc:
⚽ Welcome to Steal a Soccer Player!

How to Play:
📦 Steal lucky blocks from soccer players
⚽ Open blocks to collect rare soccer players
💰 Earn cash from your star players
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and pitch
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal lucky blocks from other players
✨ Discover rarer blocks, players and sizes!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
